name: inkforge-local-novel-studio
description: Local-first AI novel writing cockpit for solo authors.

scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace @inkforge/schemas run build && npm --workspace @inkforge/prompt-engine run build && npm --workspace @inkforge/ai-provider run build && npm --workspace @inkforge/agent-engine run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @inkforge/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @inkforge/desktop run typecheck
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @inkforge/desktop run pack
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @inkforge/desktop run dist
scripts.perf:probe:long: npm run build && cross-env PERF_VOLUMES=10 PERF_CHAPTERS_PER_VOLUME=200 PERF_CHARS_PER_CHAPTER=3500 node --import ./scripts/register-mock-electron.mjs ./scripts/perf-probe.mjs
